description: Use this when the user pastes a recipe link (any recipe site, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest or Facebook) and wants the recipe itself. Returns clean ingredients and steps without ads. Does not add anything to the user's account; call save_recipe afterwards if they want to keep it. For recipe text pasted into the chat, use create_recipe instead.

url.description: The URL to import the recipe from

name: import_recipe
title: Import recipe
